description: This file declares the exported API functions for the SLAP Object Proxy component, including functions for creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization of the proxy object.

methods.name: SlapCreateObjProxy
methods.description: Creates an object proxy instance with given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SlapOpoCreate
methods.description: Initializes and creates a new SLAP object proxy instance with specified contexts.

methods.name: SlapOpoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the specified SLAP object proxy instance.

methods.name: SlapOpoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the objects necessary for the SLAP object proxy operation.

methods.name: SlapOpoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the SLAP object proxy instance.
